headline: Join Pakistan Navy as Sailor 2026: Branches, Eligibility & Process
metaDescription: Join Pak Navy as Sailor 2026: Technical needs Matric 65%, age 16-20, 5'4" height. Register at joinpaknavy.gov.pk - Marine, Police, Chef branches.

sections.content:
The Pakistan Navy recruits sailors in batches — the 2026 intake runs as Batch A-2026(S), B-2026(S) and C-2026(S). The C-2026 batch opened online registration from 8 to 22 October 2026 at joinpaknavy.gov.pk. Recruitment is open to citizens of Pakistan from all provinces, GB and AJK.

Sailor branches are designated by letters: Technical (A), Naval Police/Regulating (C), Marine (D), Naib Khateeb (E), Chef/Steward (F), Musician (G), MTD/Driver (H), Sanitary Worker (J), PT Branch (K), plus a Female Medical Technician category and a Direct Entry Sailor (IT) track for diploma holders.
sections.title: Sailor Batches and Branches for 2026

sections.content:
The Technical branch requires Matric in Science with at least 65% marks, age 16 to 20 years on the reference date, and height of 5 feet 4 inches (162.5 cm). The Marine branch needs Matric Science at 60%, age 17 to 21 and height of 5 feet 6 inches (167.5 cm). Naval Police/Regulating accepts Matric Science or Arts at 60% but demands 5 feet 7 inches.

Chef/Steward and Musician branches accept Matric at 50% (age 16-20). MTD/Driver needs Matric plus a valid LTV/HTV driving licence with age 18-24, while Sanitary Worker needs only a Middle pass with age 17-21. Naib Khateeb requires Matric plus Dars-e-Nizami, with age up to 35. Most branches are male-only and unmarried; the Female Medical Technician category requires Matric Science (Biology) at 65% with minimum height 4 feet 8 inches.
sections.title: Branch-wise Eligibility Criteria

sections.content:
First, register online at joinpaknavy.gov.pk during the advertised window. Then report to the assigned recruitment centre with your documents for a computer-based entrance test covering intelligence and academic subjects.

Successful candidates pass the Physical Efficiency Test — running, push-ups, sit-ups and chin-ups — followed by an initial medical examination for height, weight, eyesight and deformities. A personality test and interview by the Naval Selection Board comes next, with final selection on merit by Naval Headquarters (NHQ).
sections.title: Selection Process Step by Step

sections.content:
Sailors receive a starting pay roughly between PKR 35,000 and 60,000 per month depending on branch and seniority, plus hardship and sea allowances. Benefits include free accommodation and uniform, free medical treatment for self, family and parents at naval hospitals, and subsidized education in Bahria colleges.

Careers progress from Sailor through Leading and Chief Petty Officer ranks with time-bound promotions, trade specialization courses, and opportunities for foreign courses and UN deputation for high performers.
